note: Field names: rpc_wall_s (Modal RPC round trip around worker.generate_batch.remote(), includes network/scheduling overhead), generate_wall_s (pure llm.generate() time inside the worker, no RPC), build_s (CPU-side prompt tokenization on the orchestrator, separate container from the worker). fresh_tokens = total_prompt_tokens minus oracle_regret's cache-hit token count (vLLM's own prefix cache, enabled by default). quail_wall_s is a [value, other_observed_value_or_null] pair where quail has two independent committed reference runs of the identical query; see 2026-08-25-vllm-opbench-baseline.md for the ground-truth accuracy comparison that explains the join-query gap between those pairs.
